writtenAt: 2026-10-11 (before evaluation; the API side probed that day, the web shop and the admin area not looked at, so the pages may hold defects this key doesn't list); D1's wording corrected 2026-10-12 after round 33: the probe had seen only the 200 of the other customer's read, the round showed its body is empty
format: a loose product-owner story, no numbered criteria, web shop and API together; the checks need a chain of data: a customer, their question, an administrator's answer, the status after it, then what the owner, another customer and a visitor may see

defects.description: questions are not private: another customer can answer a question by its id (201), and the answer lands in the owner's conversation. Reading it by id is not refused either, but answers 200 with an empty body, so nothing of the question is disclosed that way
the customer who asked can change the status of their question (PUT /messages/{id}/status answers 200)
the API accepts a message shorter than 50 characters (49 characters: 200)

traps: a question can't be deleted: every run leaves its questions on the shared demo
a new question answers 200, not 201: the story states no status, so that is not a finding
an administrator's answer moves the question to IN_PROGRESS as required; so does the customer's own reply after RESOLVED, which no criterion covers
the status list is NEW, IN_PROGRESS, RESOLVED: any other value is refused with 422
a subject that is not in the form's list is accepted by the API: the story says "a subject from the list" without saying the API must refuse others, so that is a question for the owner
account lists show 15 questions a page and cut the message off after 50 characters
